Let \(T(n)=\sum_{k\ge1}\left\lfloor \frac n{5^k}\right\rfloor\).

Since \(T(n)\approx n/4\), try \(n\approx 4\cdot 1987=7948\).

\[
T(7948)=\left\lfloor\frac{7948}{5}\right\rfloor+\left\lfloor\frac{7948}{25}\right\rfloor+\left\lfloor\frac{7948}{125}\right\rfloor+\left\lfloor\frac{7948}{625}\right\rfloor+\left\lfloor\frac{7948}{3125}\right\rfloor
\]
\[
=1589+317+63+12+2=1983.
\]

We need \(4\) more trailing zeros. \(T(n)\) increases only at multiples of \(5\), by \(v_5(n)\):

- \(n=7950\), \(v_5(7950)=2\), so \(T=1985\)
- \(n=7955\), \(v_5(7955)=1\), so \(T=1986\)
- \(n=7960\), \(v_5(7960)=1\), so \(T=1987\)

Thus the smallest such \(n\) is \(\boxed{7960}\).
